basics.name: Gabriel Olius Carando
basics.label: Data Consultant · MSc student in Telecommunications (UPC)
basics.summary: Data consultant at Datasofi, building a data warehouse and supporting the deployment of a production-tracking app for an industrial client. MSc student in Advanced Telecommunication Technologies at UPC, specialising in antennas, microwaves and photonics for communications and Earth observation. My BSc thesis (grade 9.5/10) compared ionospheric electron content retrieved from the SMOS satellite with ground-based ionosondes. I like turning scattered data into reliable, well-documented tools — from satellite measurements to business processes.

projects.name: Regional Analysis of SMOS-Derived VTEC and Its Consistency with Ionosonde Measurements
projects.description: Bachelor's thesis, UPC (grade 9.5/10). Supervised by Mercè Vall-Llossera Ferran and Núria Duffo Úbeda (Signal Theory and Communications Dept.).
highlights: Retrieved ionospheric VTEC from SMOS L-band full-polarimetric (L1B) data via Faraday rotation and compared it with GIRO ionosondes at six stations across low, mid and high latitudes.
Built spatio-temporal collocation (≤300 km, ±30 min) and local-time-matched maps to compare a quiet month (June 2022) with a severe geomagnetic storm (May 2024).
Found strong agreement during the storm (r = 0.93, 22 collocations) and moderate agreement in quiet conditions (r = 0.61, 92 collocations), with a bias of about +3 TECU.
Traced extreme errors at one station to L-band radio-frequency interference by inspecting brightness-temperature snapshots, and excluded it from the statistics.
